title: Clone of the watch vault 7r83qic5 with --pack-store --no-checkout worked: 129,228 files tracked, 5.3 GB, about 6.5 minutes
note: For the conductor (the brief 'how an agent clones a vault', which asks for the combination to be reported). Command: sgit clone --pack-store --no-checkout <key from a mode-600 file, on stdin> watchpack, sgit-ai v0.26.0, 28 October 2026, started about 03:10:50 UTC, finished 03:17:26 UTC (exit 0; 53 packs, 4263 MB downloaded). Result: 'Selective working copy: 0/129228 tracked file(s) checked out', in sync with remote; sgit checkout tools wrote 17 files (tools/pass.sh among them). Two notes: the client prints no per-pack progress during 'Fetching packs', so a wait of several minutes looks like a hang; and a first attempt as a plain sgit clone, interrupted, left a half-filled folder that a later clone refused ('Directory not empty'), so I removed the folder and cloned again. Not yet tried: a pass of tools/pass.sh from this clone, and sgit push (the vault server token is still to come from the editor).
